title: Vanilla+ | Standard
description: The Z+ Modpack! There are also other versionss linked below!
body:
Focus: Optimization and minimal but useful additions.

The essence of Minecraft, polished.

This modpack focuses on preserving the original Minecraft experience while fixing the technical and visual shortcomings of the base version. It includes essential performance improvements (e.g., Sodium) and quality-of-life mods that make gameplay more enjoyable (e.g., Minimap) without adding new content that interferes with vanilla progression. Ideal for players who just want to get the most out of vanilla.

Keywords: Performance, Stability, QoL (Quality of Life), Unmodified.
